_readme: R335 A-Conform — Heron (frozen spec) → OUR landing page mapping. Two modes: (a) 'explicit' — heron role path (exact or suffix match) → our CSS selector, resolved inside the section container; (b) heuristic fallback — match by structure: same tag + same text-class (tc) + same ordinal position within that (tag,tc) group in document order. Phase 2 agents add data-spec hooks and extend 'explicit'. 'ourSection' holds the REAL container selectors of our React SPA (verified against frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx r335). 'scaleFactor' multiplies fs/lh tolerances per section (Arabic renders slightly different metric heights; default 1.0 until measured). [P2-0 split: one file per our-section key, named with the EXACT key run.mjs uses — run.mjs merges every *.json in this directory. This file: why strip — section.wy-section (sections/Why.tsx).]

noCounterpart.reason: page-level wrap div above the our-section container — box identical to the bound section element; measuring both would double-count the same rect
structural head-row wrapper — no our counterpart node; all measured children (head, side, hrule) are individually bound, wrapper rect is their union
SVG defs scaffolding — non-rendering container (0x0); our inline svgs carry no defs2 node; r337 precedent: 0x0 svg scaffolding excused with written justification
SVG filter scaffolding — non-rendering (0x0); our line-art reproduces the visual without filters; r337 precedent
SVG feMerge primitive — non-rendering filter plumbing (0x0); no visual counterpart possible
SVG clipPath scaffolding — non-rendering (0x0); our crops clip via CSS overflow, r337 precedent
SVG mask scaffolding — non-rendering (0x0); our reveal masks are CSS opacity, r337 precedent
